value.rationale: For recently constructed distance-optimal binary LRCs, a complete coordinatewise parallel-repair availability law gives stronger storage-node information than locality two and [n,k,d]. It applies across all feasible triple-span geometries and explicitly distinguishes two optimal [22,5,10] codes with different repair diversity. It is a natural infinite-family structural classification, not an arbitrary small census.
